input: Register the kids for summer camp early

gold.taskTitle: Register Kids for Summer Camp Early
gold.taskDescription: Register the children for summer camp ahead of a deadline or before spots fill up.

questions.title: How many kids are you registering for camp?
questions.description: Understand the number of children involved in the registration.

questions.title: Have you already chosen a specific camp?
questions.description: Determine whether a camp has been selected or if research is still needed.

questions.title: What is the registration deadline or open date?
questions.description: Identify any known dates that define what 'early' means in this context.

questions.title: What is the camp's age range or activity focus?
questions.description: Clarify whether the camp is sports, arts, academic, general, or another type.

questions.title: Is this an in-person, overnight, or day camp?
questions.description: Understand the format of the camp being considered.

questions.title: Do you have the registration forms or account ready?
questions.description: Find out if prior setup steps are needed before registration can begin.

questions.title: Is there a deposit or full payment due at registration?
questions.description: Clarify financial requirements that need to be prepared ahead of time.
